symbols.name: prime
symbols.meaning: A prime number, an integer greater than one with no positive divisors other than one and itself.

symbols.name: second prime
symbols.meaning: A prime number different from p, used in the coprimality argument.

symbols.name: divisor
symbols.meaning: A positive integer that divides another integer.
symbols.quote: A positive integer $a$ is a divisor of an integer $m$ when $m=ak$ for some integer $k$.

symbols.name: dividend
symbols.meaning: An integer that a divisor a divides.
symbols.quote: A positive integer $a$ is a divisor of an integer $m$ when $m=ak$ for some integer $k$.

symbols.name: cofactor
symbols.meaning: An integer with m equal to a times k.
symbols.quote: A positive integer $a$ is a divisor of an integer $m$ when $m=ak$ for some integer $k$.

relations.predicate: is an integer greater than one
relations.quote: A prime number is an [Integer](integer.md) greater than one whose only positive divisors are one and itself.
